question: Can I put my secret key in frontend environment variables?
response_english_translation: No. Frontend code is distributed with the application, so the secret key must not be placed in a browser or other distributed application. Use it only in server-side components you control. Whether a secret key bypasses RLS depends on whether the request carries a user access token: without one it bypasses RLS; with one, the request follows the signed-in user’s RLS policies.
